data.narrative:
WB Group is a pre-IPO Defense & Security company founded by Piotr Wojciechowski, Adam Bartosiewicz, and Krzysztof Wysocki. The valuation exercise draws from a comp universe of 10 identified peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Standard peer-median methodology is not applicable here. Of 23 same-sector peers identified in Defense & Security, none satisfy narrow stage and tier-matching filters required for reliable triangulation. Specifically, the analysis found zero same-stage comps, zero adjacent-stage comps, and zero similar-valuation-tier comps meeting the minimum threshold of three datapoints. A sector-wide median approach would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, technology maturity, and revenue profiles across Defense & Security.

Without sufficient narrow-peer anchors, this valuation cannot be supported by quantitative triangulation methods. Additional data on comparable transaction multiples, revenue run-rate, or stage-specific fundraising benchmarks within pre-IPO defense firms would be required to establish a defensible range. The core uncertainty is the absence of Stage and Scale alignment within the peer set—a limitation that precludes reliable inference from current market comparables.
